Codie does not turn off. Magic tricks and singing are distractions from building equity and holding the purse strings. Codie treats life as a masterclass in grit, not a performance space for hobbies. RESET. Codie has zero use for systems of joy when there are boring businesses to buy and portfolios to scale. If Ali is prioritizing family milestones and pantomime over relentless execution, the deal is dead. Pass the check, because Codie needs a partner in leverage, not a lifestyle coach.
